flags.why: The common everyday meaning 'tofu', as in đậu rán or một bìa đậu, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91%E1%BA%ADu)).
Đậu meaning 'park a vehicle' is mainly Southern usage.
Đậu phộng means 'peanut', but đậu does not independently mean nuts in general.
flags.fix: Remove this sense; đậu phộng belongs under the bean/legume sense.

flags.why: Chuẩn does not mean 'suitable' in the construction chuẩn với dáng của anh.
Sát chồng attributes a husband's premature death to his wife's fate, rather than simply predicting widowhood ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-s%C3%A1t)).
flags.fix: The fortune teller said her fate would cause her husband to die prematurely.

flags.why: Calling someone thần kinh meaning 'crazy' is derogatory and can offend.
Kem does not have a separate meaning 'smoothie' or 'frozen drink' ([dictionary](https://thuvienvh.online/tu-dien-tv/kem/)).

The respectful use of phu nhân for a high-status man's wife remains current and is not restricted to historical settings ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-phu%20nh%C3%A2n)).
The everyday colloquial meaning 'only; just', as in độc một người, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91%E1%BB%99c)).
